wiring.note: This spec is a photo draft — every value in it is labelled ESTIMATED in the spec itself, and the wiring inherits that. The Dynamixel bus carries power and telemetry on one connection; the motors are rated at the 11.1 V battery voltage in the spec. The Pi is the 'Pi' in Waffle Pi; its 5 V requirement is the Raspberry Pi supply spec in the parts catalog. Harness-check data (2026-10-27): the Dynamixel bus logic level (5 V TTL) is ROBOTIS's published figure for the XL430 (e-Manual: 'TTL Multidrop Bus (5V Logic)'), the Pi's GPIO logic is 3.3 V per the Raspberry Pi documentation, and the bus cables terminate in the same Robot Cable-X3P plug at both ends (ROBOTIS cable table). Currents and gauges stay unrecorded: ROBOTIS publishes only stall current for the XL430 — a peak its own manual warns is not a continuous rating — so no load current is claimed.
